units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:1">Tam. II, 1</cite> <he>סוֹלְקִין</he> Talm. ed., v. <cite ref="O01257"><he>סָנַק</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:4">Sabb. XX, 4</cite> <he>גורפין … ומְסַלְּקִין לצדדין</he> you may rake … and remove to the corners.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:7">Nidd. IV, 7</cite>, a. e. <he>מְסַלֶּקֶת</he> suspends, v. <cite ref="H01600"><he>חֲרָדָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:7">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> <he>סִלַּקְתָּ אותו</he> thou hast discarded him (omitted to mention him in connection with the Lord); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוּלָּק</he>; f. <he>מְסוּלֶּקֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְסוּלָּקִים</he>, <he>מְסוּלָּקִין</he>; <he>מְסוּלָּקוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Niddah 68b:18">Nidd. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>דמיה מס׳</he> her menstruation is suspended. Y. Keth. IX, beg. 32ᵈ if one uses the expression <he>ידיי מס׳ וכ׳</he> my hands are removed, my feet are removed from this field, he has said nothing (has not thereby renounced his rights); a. e.

senses.gloss: to lift up, raise, esp. to tuck up the trail of a garment.
units: Zeb. 18ᵇ מרושלין שסִילְּקָן … כשרין trailing (priestly) garments when tucked up by the belt, are fit for service; a. e.—Part. pass. as ab. lifted up, too short.
<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 1:8">Tosef. Men. I, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 18a:11">Zeb. 18ᵃ</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="T01089"><he>רָשַׁל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54b">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ אהרן וכ׳</he> Aaron was dismissed (got up) and took his seat to the left of Moses; <he>נִסְתַּלְּקוּ בניו</he> when his sons were dismissed.
<cite ref="Yevamot 64a:1">Yeb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>גורם … שתִּסְתַּלֵּק מישראל</he> causes the Divine Presence to withdraw from Israel.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:8">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>וראשון ראשון מִסְתַּלֵּק</he> and one after the other rose (from the meal).
Ab. I, 16 עשה לך רב והִסְתַּלֵּק מן הספק get thyself a teacher so as to be removed from (to escape) doubt; a. fr.—Esp. (with or without מן העולם) to be called away from this world, to die.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite> <he>הקב״ה יודע … להִסְתַּלֵּק העולם ומְסַלְּקָן</he> the Lord knows when it is time for the righteous to be called away …, and he does call them away.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>היה מִסְתַּלֵּק וכ׳</he> was about to die; a. fr.
